label: Founded coming-to-be controls checked
meaning: The initial-state rival survives, without a necessary individual and with inert emptiness intact, in exactly the two ways the derivation leaves open: an endless past in which every contingent thing comes to be, and a founded past whose contingent thing never came to be. Each control omits one conjunct of founded coming-to-be. The rooted control shows the premise is satisfiable. Model claims concern these interpretations only.
